summary: SDKs need to accept both enum form (INDEXED_VALUE_TYPE_KEYWORD_LIST) and string form (KeywordList) for search attribute type metadata, matching the server's lenient deserialization behavior.
userImpact: SDKs may fail to deserialize search attributes from server that use either enum or string type representations, causing inconsistent behavior across SDKs.
rootCause: SDKs are stricter than server in validating type metadata format for search attribute payloads.
proposedFix: Update typed search attribute logic in all SDKs to accept both INDEXED_VALUE_TYPE_KEYWORD_LIST and KeywordList forms in type metadata.
keyQuote: SDKs need to be similarly lenient when reading search attributes coming from server.
